A locally shadowed `const index` inside the arrow function is not excluded because the reference map/name lookup doesn't respect that the inner declaration rebinds `index` within the function scope, so the outer each binding is (wrongly) treated as referenced, forcing an inline (non-hoisted) handler for button B while C (renamed to `i`) correctly hoists to `var on_click`.
